lessonTitle: Interviewing for MSL and Medical Advisor roles

slides.title: A Predictable, Four-Stage Structure
bullets: An initial phone screening interview usually comes first
A deeper interview with the hiring team follows
Psychometric aptitude and work-style tests are common
A final stage often includes a clinical presentation and a role-play simulation

slides.title: Prepare for the KOL Visit Simulation
bullets: The panel evaluates conversational skill, not just scientific knowledge
Apply the scientific exchange and active listening principles from earlier in the course
Avoid a sales pitch disguised as scientific conversation
Experienced evaluators spot that error easily

slides.title: Choose a Topic That Shows Depth and Clarity
bullets: Pick a topic that demonstrates both scientific depth and clear communication
Structure it using the executive communication principles from this module
Start with the central message and use well-selected, visually clear data
Be ready to defend methodology and limitations under follow-up questions

slides.title: Updated Sector Knowledge Sets Candidates Apart
bullets: Track recent drug approvals, notable congress abstracts and indication expansions
Concrete, current references demonstrate genuine active interest in the field
Recruiters consistently value this over purely theoretical knowledge

slides.title: Questions to the Interviewer Signal Judgment
bullets: Ask genuinely about career progression opportunities within the organization
Ask how success is measured in the role
Ask about the product's Medical Plan structure and priorities
This signals strategic reflection, not just interest in any open position

slides.title: The Interview Applies the Whole Course
bullets: Preparing this thoroughly is not an isolated exercise
It is a practical application of nearly every competency built throughout this course

takeaway.title: Interview preparation is a live rehearsal of nearly every skill this course has built
bullets: The role-play tests genuine scientific exchange, not a disguised sales pitch
The clinical presentation should apply executive communication principles
Current sector knowledge and thoughtful questions signal real, active interest
